svg.title: Checked contrast: supplied dominance establishes the probability; missing dominance leaves it unresolved

g.text: THE SAME CROSS, A DIFFERENT ASSUMPTION RECORD
Question: does an Aa × Aa cross give dominant phenotype probability 3/4?
Complete dominance, equal segregation, random fertilization.
The phenotype probability is not established.
Both evaluations are COMPUTED. Disputed dominance is BOTH at input and also leaves the probability NEITHER.
